top5.title: Spatial heterogeneity in glioblastoma: linking single-cell and spatial multi-omics to vaccine immunotherapy
top5.why: Spatial omics reveal glioblastoma's layered immune and metabolic architecture, defining immunosuppressive niches and malignant cell-state distributions relevant for vaccine design.

top5.title: KRAS(G12D)-targeted therapy sensitivity depends on interferon signaling activation in pancreatic cancer
top5.why: Interferon-beta activation restores KRAS inhibitor sensitivity in pancreatic cancers with suppressed interferon signaling and sustained MYC activity.

top5.title: Deep Lineage: Single-cell lineage tracing and fate inference using deep learning
top5.why: Deep Lineage enables prediction of early cell fate biases and gene expression trajectories from time-series single-cell RNA-seq with lineage barcoding, outperforming existing methods.

top5.title: Retraction Note: Engineered outer membrane vesicles enhance solid tumour CAR-T cell therapy
top5.why: Primary research in a leading specialist journal. Topics: car-t.

top5.title: Author Correction: Inactivated vaccine-elicited potent antibodies can broadly neutralize SARS-CoV-2 circulating variants
top5.why: Primary research in a leading specialist journal. Topics: vaccine.

also.title: Neoantigen nanovaccines for cancer immunotherapy: design strategies, translational bottlenecks, and clinical prospects
also.why: Nanocarriers can overcome antigen degradation and inefficient dendritic-cell activation in neoantigen vaccines, though immunogenicity induction does not guarantee clinical benefit, requiring patient stratification and tumor microenvironment modulation.

also.title: Heterogeneous contributions of APOBEC3 deaminases to substitution and indel mutagenesis in lung adenocarcinoma
also.why: APOBEC3A and APOBEC3B show heterogeneous contributions to mutagenesis in lung adenocarcinoma, with APOBEC3A causally generating indels, but mRNA/protein levels fail to predict individual paralog activities.

also.title: Intrinsic resistance to KRAS inhibition: Interfering with interferon
also.why: Sustained MYC activity suppresses innate immune signaling as the primary mechanism of intrinsic KRAS inhibitor resistance in pancreatic cancer.

also.title: Diagnostic evaluation of long-read nanopore sequencing for pediatric CNS tumors
also.why: Nanopore sequencing achieves copy-number and methylation-based classification concordant with clinical standards for most pediatric CNS tumor types, though structural variant detection and diffuse glioma classification remain less reliable than short-read methods.

also.title: In situ reprogramming of glioma stem cells into dendritic cell-like cells for glioblastoma immunotherapy
also.why: Reprogramming glioblastoma stem cells into dendritic-like cells via lipid nanoparticle-delivered transcription factors converts immunologically cold tumors and elicits sustained anti-tumor T-cell responses in mice.

also.title: Intra-articular biomaterial injection as a management option for canine stifle disease: navigating the evidence gap
also.why: Primary research in a field journal. Topics: canine.
